description: This file defines a message queue system with message handling, including classes for messages, a message queue, and specific message types for setting position and duration. It includes thread management, synchronization primitives, and external GStreamer library references.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Abstract base class for messages with a virtual handle method.

classes.name: CallInEventLoopMessage
classes.description: A message that encapsulates a function to be called within the event loop, with synchronization to wait for completion.

classes.name: MessageQueue
classes.description: Manages a thread-safe queue of messages, with methods to start, stop, post messages, and process them in a separate thread.

classes.name: SetPositionMessage
classes.description: A message to set a new position value, updating a target position reference.

classes.name: SetDurationMessage
classes.description: A message to set a new duration value, updating a target duration reference.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the message processing thread if not already running.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the message processing thread and clears the message queue.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all messages from the queue.

methods.name: waitForMessage
methods.description: Blocks until a message is available in the queue and returns it.

methods.name: postMessage
methods.description: Posts a message to the queue if the queue is running.

methods.name: processMessages
methods.description: Continuously processes messages from the queue until stopped.

methods.name: callInEventLoopImpl
methods.description: Executes a function in the event loop thread, posting it as a message if called from another thread.

methods.name: callInEventLoop
methods.description: Template method to call a function with arguments in the event loop thread.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Pure virtual method to handle the message, implemented by subclasses.
